text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Rhein Kraft won't be able to race 
anymore." —A few days had passed since 
that notice arrived. Daring Heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, at the very end... my legs gave out 
on me...
choice_data_list:
...It's a little early, but shall we take 
a break?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, sorry, thank you.
choice_data_list:
(They can't seem to concentrate on 
training...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was waiting for her to come to the 
'perch' on her own, but... if she loses 
focus, the risk of injury goes up. Above 
all else—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—It's not that I didn't want to talk about 
it. It's just... I'm still feeling 
conflicted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought she was just feeling down about 
Rhein Kraft, but... there seems to be 
another factor causing her to lose focus.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? ...I might not be very good 
at talking."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I don't think your full-of-confidence 
queen is anywhere to be found.
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about it, I'm a perch after 
all.

Don't worry about it, I'm a perch after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……That's right.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, Tact asked me to coach 
her."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I don't mean right this 
instant. I'd like to ask you after 
Heart-san's races have settled down."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"‘Would you come and watch my training in 
person?’"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "It was your heart—that I came to admire."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Whether in a race or at summer training 
camp... Seeing you embrace and enjoy harsh 
conditions was dazzling to behold."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I have seen the sheer vitality of nature 
in the mountains since childhood— and I 
feel that very same power within your 
heart."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I was truly happy. She looked straight 
at my strengths without looking away."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Connecting my heart to Tact— don't you 
think a path like that is wonderful, too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It means dedicating myself to mentoring 
the next generation. Stepping back from 
the front lines—just like Cesario. 
Bringing an end to her youth...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, just like she said... we're 
not talking about right this second, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, we have to start preparing next 
year, don't we? We never know when her 
growth spurt might kick in—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As a Tiara Umamusume, I want to give 
thorough, one-on-one guidance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tiara Umamusume training clubs are often 
run with small numbers. They choose a 
method of closer, more attentive guidance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The first three years, so vital for an 
Umamusume... I enjoyed them to the 
absolute fullest. More than anyone ever 
could.
choice_data_list:
...And your three years will come to an 
end this year.

...And your three years will come to an 
end this year.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, because... either way, you can't 
run forever, can you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Past the peak――once you're past your 
peak, it's all downhill from there. The 
newer generation pulls further and further 
ahead...――"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Just fading away into the shadows of 
history. If that's the case— I thought 
moving on to the next step while my body 
is still healthy... might not be such a 
bad idea."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If the kids I teach make a name for 
themselves, maybe people will say, "Ah, 
she was the mentor of that Craft 
generation"...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's the only thing I can do for her. 
...Because Craft and I won't ever clash in 
a race again.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: There isn't any.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
One look in her eyes, and you'll 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The size of the shadow cast upon that 
heart— the depth of that despair.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I'll never have another chance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Clashing our hearts against each other... 
never, ever again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Now I understand. Having lost the 
rival she always chased after— Daring 
Heart has lost her reason to run."
choice_data_list:
(On top of that, Tact came to consult with 
me...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...You can't clash hearts all by 
yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Someday, I have to grow up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The time to change... must be right now. 
My youth—is over."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever she clashed heart-to-heart with 
her rivals, she was always so full of 
life— she truly seemed to be having the 
time of her life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As if embodying the radiant brilliance of 
youth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, her eyes are fixed only on 
what she 'ought to do'... Perhaps she 
hasn't been facing her true feelings. If 
so—"
choice_data_list:
I'd like to change Saturday's training 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Let's go out for the whole day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you can return this ball!? 
—Heartbeat Smash!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*plump...*)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! 6-0! This set is my win too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Did you want me to? I thought you'd 
prefer a direct head-to-head match♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Besides, isn't today's date... one where 
you're supposed to treat me, rather than 
the other way around?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm certainly the one who invited her out 
for a break and planned the schedule. I've 
already got more things lined up that 
she'll enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I won't think about a thing 
and just enjoy myself to the absolute 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, get your racket ready! We're going 
for at least five more sets~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Oh? This aquarium...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...How strange, the fish aren't moving. 
Almost like ornaments—"

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—The time has come. From this moment on— 
the Terrifying Shark Zombie Park is 
officially open."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...!? Zombie Shark Park...!?
"Shark...! Shark shark...!"
choice_data_list: Whoa, there's a huge shark in the tank!?

text_block_list.text: "Ooooh...! Ooooooooh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Zombies are coming from deep inside...! 
—Wait, are we in total checkmate?"

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"‘From this moment on, you must escape 
this facility infested with sharks and 
zombies—using your courage, wisdom, and 
the bonds between you!’"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right, guess we just have to do it. 
Trainer, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—If it's us, we can break free! Let's 
go!”

text_block_list.name: A Certain Famous Singer
text_block_list.text:
"Tokyo, are you ready for tonight? I've 
finally returned to Japan!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Famous Singer
text_block_list.text:
"The respect. The love. The heart――Dance! 
This night is for you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I'd get to see such a 
superstar up this close...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How did you manage to get premium tickets 
like these!?
choice_data_list: I really just got it by chance.
I really just got it by chance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After learning she had a performance 
today, I glued myself to ticket resale 
sites hoping for a cancellation... and 
managed to snag one."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, oh, oh, oh! Oh oh oh oh oh~ oh whoa 
oh oh~ Oh oh!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer, she just looked at me! I know 
she did!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, a Queen showdown, is it! I won't 
lose~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, enjoying our day off to the 
fullest with Daring Heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So this is what satisfying exhaustion 
feels like. This feels good...
choice_data_list: Did you have a good time?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so! It feels as if my heart 
has been wiped completely clean.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaaa...!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...It just made me remember what happened 
at the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
After stripping everything away, the first 
thing that comes to mind— is the 
exhilaration of that day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I had fun. Without thinking about 
anything, just chasing Craft... chasing 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was able to throw everything I had into 
it, following my heart. —I truly believed 
it would last forever...
choice_data_list:
...Could you really bring yourself to 
leave those days behind?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...... But—what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can stay the same forever. In 
fact, right now, I'm... all alone...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh...—
choice_data_list:
Your running carries the passion of those 
days.

Your running still carries the heat of 
those days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart bravely relished facing her 
rivals— and spread that fiery passion to 
the crowd. Whenever she runs—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Will I carry those days—into the 
future...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Like Pandora, girls with new kinds of 
power are already starting to emerge.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The situation only grows more harsh for 
me. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Physical strength will surely fade. 
However— even time cannot steal an 
unyielding will. And even if it should 
crumble—
choice_data_list: I'll support you all the way.
I'll support you no matter how far we go.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're a wonderful Trainer. I'm sure you 
will achieve great feats down the line. 
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: Tell me. Do you need to change?
Tell me. Do you need to change?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
…………You're always like that, aren't you? 
You always affirm me... just as I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I love running. I truly love racing, 
where hearts clash against one another.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I am Daring Heart. No matter the 
situation, I can face it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Even if I end up all alone, I'll keep 
surviving!
choice_data_list: That's it! That's what makes you... you.
Yes! That is truly... who you are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. ...Thank you so 
much...
